text:
tess: Quick note / kickoff: running a short scan for ownerless KMS keys and stale admin grants this week. Goal: identify low-risk candidates for a dry-run removal. Who can pair on log correlation?

andre: happy to help with log joins. scope non-prod first? avoids surprises for customers.

mich: yep, non-prod -> canary -> prod. also want a way to detect keys used only by ad-hoc debugging shells.

tess: plan: export entitlements, join KMS audit for last 120 days, flag principals with zero or single events and no `iam-owner` tag. quick export: `./infra/ent dump --since=2024-01-01 --filter='resource:kms OR role:admin' > /tmp/ent.csv`

andre: i'll run the BigQuery join and produce `last_seen`, `usage_count`, and `owner` columns. Sample SQL: `SELECT e.principal,e.key_id,MAX(a.timestamp) AS last_seen,COUNT(a.*) AS usage_count,ANY_VALUE(e.owner) as owner FROM entitlements e LEFT JOIN kms_logs a ON e.principal=a.principal AND e.key_id=a.key_id GROUP BY e.principal,e.key_id HAVING COUNT(a.*)=0 OR MAX(a.timestamp) < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 120 DAY)`

sec-bot: snapshot saved: `gs://ci-backups/ent-snap-1758000000.json` (2.9MB, 1,092 rows). Restore with `./infra/ent apply --from=...`

mich: outreach template proposal: "Hi @<owner>, our audit shows an admin/KMS grant for key <key_id> with no recorded usage in 120 days. Reply within 48h if you need it or we will schedule removal. If this is used by a scheduled job, please link the runbook."

andre: add a checkbox link to attest via the ticket. If owner missing, auto-assign to `sec-oncall` for manual review.

tess: Canary: pick 3 non-prod keys with single-owner and low traffic, remove admin role in staging, run integration tests + scheduler replay for 24h. Monitor `kms.access_denied` and `service.error` rates. If spike >3 errors in 10m, auto-rollback.

mich: i'll coordinate scheduler replay with SRE. also flag keys that are referenced by third-party integrations (oauth clients) 3 those we should not touch without extra review.

andre: adding a column `third_party` from oauth registry join. will post CSV by EOD.

audit-bot: candidate list generated: 47 entries, 12 ownerless, 35 with owners. Link: `https://internal/redwood/ent-candidates/1758000000.csv`

tess: volunteers: andre -> BigQuery joins, mich -> outreach template + runbook checklist, tess -> canary coord and rollback scripts. Meeting Thursday 10am PT to approve canary.

mich: small ask: include `rotation_policy` and `last_key_rotation` in the report so compliance can triage exceptions quickly.

tess: good call. andre, can you add those fields?

andre: yes, adding now. I'll also include a `risk_score` computed from usage_count, last_seen, multi_owner, and third_party flags.

tess: awesome. If anyone sees a key that looks business-critical that slipped into the candidate set, flag `#access-review` and mention me immediately.

mich: noted. I'll draft the outreach messages and the FAQ for false positives (ephemeral dev keys, test harnesses, rebuild pipelines).

tess: thanks team. Keeping this surgical and auditable. :lock:
